basic_info.description: Charming and fully detached Westwood Park bungalow featuring 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom. This home is filled with period details, including mahogany inlay on the refinished hardwood floors, gumwood accents in the living and dining rooms, and a built-in hutch in the dining room.  The spacious living room boasts a wood-burning fireplace and bay windows,with a swinging door leading to the bathroom and two spacious bedrooms. An updated, sunlit, south-facing kitchen includes a delightful breakfast nook. Stairs off the kitchen lead to the laundry, access to the backyard and massive garage which offers tremendous expansion potential. Whether you're looking to settle into Westwood Park or create your forever home, this property is ready to fulfill your vision. Ideally located near shops and public transportation on both Ocean Avenue and Monterey Boulevard.
